root_objective: Make the existing Guide/CURRENT path compile imperfect human intent into high-fidelity agentic missions, let generic workers solve bounded multi-step local work and discover bounded children, learn from normal operation, and continue without artificial human gates.
authority_boundary: This campaign is a durable portfolio/work projection only. Work Graph/portfolio/CURRENT/allocator/PIN remain execution authority; GUIDE_PLANNER remains planning role; compiled-dispatch remains evidence/pre-dispatch gate; no new scheduler, queue, CURRENT, planner, worker family, storage authority or telemetry truth owner is created.

live_frontier_observation.truth_boundary: claim-frontier is a compact hint; atomic PIN create remains authority. M5/M6 are durable seed_status=ready jobs but are not in the current compact exposed slice and should surface as capacity is consumed/refreshed.

fan_in.activation_rule: Materialize/activate through existing Guide/CURRENT only after the initial six returns have enough evidence to integrate; independent FAIL/PARTIAL lanes create bounded repairs without freezing siblings.
done_when: Specification assurance feeds the existing compiled-dispatch gate.
Agentic mission autonomy remains bounded by packet scope and authority.
Dynamic children pass compiled-dispatch, consumer, capability, dedupe and recursion checks.
Passive stats are derived evidence, not truth authority.
Artificial human gates are removed without bypassing real human authority boundaries.
Adversarial correction fixture measures pre-dispatch anticipation rather than post-hoc cleverness.

capacity_policy: First materialize useful compatible READY missions. Then request only max(0, useful_ready_compatible - live_compatible). Do not launch 20/50/100 shells from desired scale alone; let grounded child discovery expand the frontier recursively.
privacy_boundary: Only sanitized mission metadata and repository evidence refs are durable here. No raw private chat body, credentials, headers, secrets or hidden reasoning are included.
